scope: Different-author read-only review of the uniquely consumed M1798 C3 production attempt, its atomically isolated failure, the unsealed private build transcript, and the one-shot M1806 public-X/Z forensic diagnostic. No VCS, DC, Formality, PrimeTime, PTPX, license query, commit, push, result mutation, predecessor mutation, or docs359 mutation was performed.
verdict: FAIL_CLOSED for energy admission, with a narrow additive recovery path. M1798 consumed exactly one production attempt and stopped after one VCS compile and one mapped simulation; no SAIF and no PTPX run exist. The sealed failure receipt and sealed attempt latch are internally consistent, the canonical result is absent, and raw build evidence remains explicitly unsealed/do-not-cite. M1806 localizes the first post-reset unknowns to six public debug counters only; all 28 architectural/control outputs and the other five debug counters are binary at the same cycle-9 sample. The diagnostic terminates at that first cycle and therefore does not prove whether the six counters settle by the three quiescent post-release clocks already intended by the workload. The mapped library/netlist do not consume the UNIT_DELAY macro and no SDF is applied, so relabeling or rerunning as zero-delay is not a causal repair. The preferred successor is an additive testbench that keeps immediate architectural X/Z checking, gives only the debug counters the existing bounded three-cycle quiescent reset-release interval, then hard-requires every public signal binary and all debug counters exactly zero before configuration. Existing public checks and scoreboards must remain active for the complete workload.

m1806_diagnostic.why_not: The inherited fatal check terminates at cycle 9, before the intended three quiescent post-reset clocks complete.

mapped_reset_and_delay_analysis.rtl_reset_semantics: synchronous active-high reset in always_ff @(posedge clk_core)
mapped_reset_and_delay_analysis.reset_mapping_interpretation: Most sequential reset behavior is implemented in mapped D cones; DFKCNQD1 CN is tied high for 10504 instances. The cell model forms D_i=CN&D and samples through tsmc_dff on the positive clock edge.
mapped_reset_and_delay_analysis.current_functional_gate_delay_interpreta: effectively zero-delay for the relevant supplied library/netlist; UNIT_DELAY is a label, not an observed timing model

repair_decision.reason: The existing run already has no SDF and the relevant functional cell paths are zero; changing the delay label cannot establish counter initialization. The existing workload explicitly reserves three post-release quiescent clocks, but its aggregate public check fires on the first one. A bounded split check preserves immediate architectural observability and proves the debug counters are clean before any traffic.

minimal_additive_successor.reset_sequence: retain eight asserted posedges and negedge deassertion
minimal_additive_successor.immediate_gate: From the first post-release posedge, keep checking all 28 architectural/control outputs for X/Z and require no accept/issue/retire activity during quiescence.
minimal_additive_successor.bounded_debug_settling_gate: Use exactly the three already intended quiescent post-release posedges; do not drive configuration or raw traffic during them. At the boundary require all 11 debug counters binary and exactly zero.
minimal_additive_successor.post_settling_gate: Enable the original full aggregate public X/Z check on every subsequent cycle and retain every result/tag/beat/tile-done/retire/counter/stall/conservation gate through warmup and eight measured tiles.
must_preserve: one legal release and retire-cycle check
forbidden: deleting or weakening post-settling public checks
minimal_additive_successor.execution_gate: Source-only additive successor, different-author static hammer, then a new exact-identity double-sealed release before any fresh mapped VCS/SAIF/PTPX campaign.

findings.finding: M1806 stops at the first post-reset cycle and cannot show whether the six debug counters become binary during the three quiescent clocks already intended by the workload.
findings.impact: Neither a persistent mapped-state defect nor a bounded reset-release settling artifact has been distinguished, so another production energy launch is not yet justified.
findings.minimal_fix: Create an additive top that keeps immediate architectural X/Z checks, gives only debug counters the exact three-cycle quiescent interval, then hard-requires every debug counter binary and zero before traffic and restores the complete aggregate check thereafter. Obtain a different-author source hammer and new sealed release before EDA.

findings.finding: The campaign calls the gate simulation UNIT_DELAY_functional, but UNIT_DELAY is not consumed by the supplied standard-cell model or mapped netlist; no SDF is applied and the relevant specify arcs are zero.
findings.impact: The label can be mistaken for timing simulation and makes option B appear causally distinct when it is not.
findings.minimal_fix: Describe the successor as zero-delay mapped functional activity simulation with timing independently established by M1456 PrimeTime; do not claim timing simulation from the activity run.
